_comment: Hand-maintained events. Rockets come from the live API; these do not exist in any API, so they live here. Add/edit freely — the site reads this file at load. Dates are local Eastern. confidence: confirmed | preliminary

events.name: NAS Jacksonville Air Show
events.detail: Blue Angels. Thunderbirds are also listed for this date on the USAF schedule — rare double-team billing, but the two calendars disagree, so treat the Thunderbirds half as unconfirmed.

events.name: Blue Angels Homecoming Air Show
events.detail: Season finale at the squadron's home field. First homecoming since 2024 — the 2025 edition was cancelled during the government shutdown.

events.name: Sun 'n Fun Aerospace Expo
events.detail: Second-largest aviation expo in the US and the traditional opener of the airshow season. Blue Angels expected Apr 10–11 on the team's preliminary schedule; the teams rotate here year to year. Night airshows midweek.

events.name: Wings Over Ocala
events.detail: Blue Angels on the preliminary 2027 schedule. Closest they get to Gainesville — roughly a 40-minute drive.

events.name: Air Dot Show Fort Lauderdale
events.detail: Blue Angels over the beach. Preliminary 2027 date.

events.name: Pensacola Beach Air Show
events.detail: Over-water show. Thursday practice and Friday dress rehearsal are usually as good as Saturday and far less crowded.

events.name: Jacksonville Beach Sea & Sky Airshow
events.detail: Blue Angels on the preliminary 2027 schedule. Beach show, free viewing.
